text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that stop control be authorized at seven uncontrolled three-way intersections in the Botany Hill Road area in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on Cresswell Drive at Botany Hill Road (north intersection). 2. Authorized compulsory stop control for southbound traffic on Cresswell Drive at Botany Hill Road (south intersection). 3. Authorized compulsory stop control for southbound traffic on Madras Crescent at Hapley Drive (east intersection). 4. Authorized compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Hapley Drive at Madras Crescent (west intersection). 5. Authorized compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Hapley Drive at Cresswell Drive. 6. Authorized compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Plover Road at Botany Hill Road. 7. Authorized compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Doucett Place at Botany Hill Road.
